subject.title: [Bug]: The project won't start on Windows and WSL.

question: Should maintainers require a current-main Windows/WSL second-build repro before choosing the build-tool fix, or treat the existing screenshot and dependency claim as enough to sponsor a tsdown rollback/update investigation now?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose between a broad tsdown-to-tsc rollback, a dependency upgrade/pin, and a wrapper-level fix without maintainer direction plus platform proof.

options.title: Require focused platform repro first
options.body: Ask for or run current-main Windows and WSL first-build and second-build logs before deciding the repair shape.

options.title: Sponsor build-tool investigation now
options.body: Treat the issue as beta-blocking enough to have a maintainer investigate tsdown, rolldown-plugin-dts, and rollback options immediately.

options.title: Wait for reporter logs
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not prioritize repair until the reporter adds full logs and exact environment details.

recommendation.title: Require focused platform repro first
recommendation.body: Ask for or run current-main Windows and WSL first-build and second-build logs before deciding the repair shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Windows tsdown wrapper and process-tree history makes this the best available routing owner for the platform/build-tool decision.
